characteristic_features: CRAB: hyperCalcemia, Renal impairment, Anaemia, Bone lesions (lytic)
characteristic_extramedullary_sites: rare: CNS, liver, lung, pleural effusions in advanced/refractory disease
heme_involvement_pattern.staging_system: R-ISS (albumin, β2-microglobulin, LDH, high-risk cytogenetics — del17p, t(4;14), t(14;16)). Newer R2-ISS incorporates gain(1q).

biomarkers.name: SPEP + IFE + urine protein electrophoresis (UPEP) + urine IFE + serum FLC
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnosis, response monitoring (IMWG criteria), disease type classification (IgG/IgA/light-chain/non-secretory/oligosecretory)

biomarkers.name: β2-microglobulin, albumin, LDH
biomarkers.clinical_use: Components of ISS/R-ISS staging (I, II, III). LDH also independently prognostic

biomarkers.name: Cytogenetics by FISH — high-risk panel
biomarkers.clinical_use: High-risk: t(4;14)/FGFR3-MMSET (~15%), t(14;16)/MAF (~3-5%), t(14;20)/MAFB (~1-2%, rare), del(17p)/TP53 (~5-10% at diagnosis), gain(1q)/1q amp (~30-40%). Standard-risk: t(11;14)/CCND1 (~15-20%), t(6;14), hyperdiploidy

biomarkers.name: t(11;14) CCND1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Standard risk overall; BCL2-dependent subset — venetoclax shows high activity in t(11;14) MM

biomarkers.name: CD38
biomarkers.prevalence: Near-universal high expression on myeloma plasma cells
biomarkers.clinical_use: Daratumumab, isatuximab (anti-CD38 mAbs) — foundational: dara-VRd (PERSEUS, GRIFFIN) frontline; isa-KRd; dara-Rd (MAIA)

biomarkers.name: BCMA (B-cell maturation antigen, TNFRSF17)
biomarkers.prevalence: Near-universal expression on myeloma plasma cells
biomarkers.clinical_use: Multiple modalities: BCMA CAR-T (idecabtagene vicleucel — KarMMa; ciltacabtagene autoleucel — CARTITUDE); BCMA×CD3 bispecifics (teclistamab, elranatamab); belantamab mafodotin (ADC)

biomarkers.name: GPRC5D
biomarkers.prevalence: Highly expressed on most myeloma cells
biomarkers.clinical_use: Talquetamab (GPRC5D×CD3 bispecific) — approved for R/R MM (MonumenTAL-1)

biomarkers.name: MRD assessment (multiparameter flow cytometry, NGS clonoSEQ, PET-CT)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Undetectable MRD (uMRD) at 10^-5 or 10^-6 is powerful prognostic marker; treatment de-escalation studies ongoing

biomarkers.name: Whole-body low-dose CT / MRI / PET-CT
biomarkers.clinical_use: Replaces older skeletal survey. Focal PET-avid lesions post-treatment predict relapse

biomarkers.name: Extramedullary disease (EMD) presence
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adverse; often plasmablastic morphology; poor response to standard therapy

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Marrow infiltration by clonal plasma cells (≥10%) with cytologic atypia, aberrant clustering, and myeloma-defining events/end-organ damage (CRAB features)
variants: by isotype: IgG (~50-60%), IgA (~20%), light-chain only (~15-20%), IgD (~1-2%), IgE (very rare), non-secretory/oligosecretory (rare)
by morphology: plasmacytic (mature), plasmablastic (immature, worse prognosis), anaplastic
histomorphological_subtype.grading: R-ISS / R2-ISS staging; molecular subtypes (high-risk cytogenetics) drive risk

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Bone marrow niche dependency — plasma cells depend on stromal support (IL-6, VEGF, CXCL12); CD38, BCMA, GPRC5D, FcRH5 targetable across multiple modalities (mAbs, ADCs, CAR-T, bispecifics); MM-directed T cell therapies transforming outcomes
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Diffuse or focal marrow plasma cell infiltration displacing normal haematopoiesis; osteoclast activation causes lytic bone lesions; occasional focal plasmacytomas

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Terminally differentiated plasma cells derived from post-germinal centre B cells; long-lived plasma cells reside in bone marrow niches
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Terminal plasma cell differentiation (CD138+, CD38 bright, IRF4+, PRDM1/BLIMP1+) with clonal Ig production; retains extensive normal plasma cell biology (Ig secretion, marrow niche dependency, BCMA expression)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Plasma cell lineage retention explains therapeutic strategy — targeting plasma cell-specific antigens (CD38 → daratumumab, isatuximab; BCMA → CAR-T, bispecifics, ADC; GPRC5D → bispecific; FcRH5 → bispecific); plasmablastic morphology in extramedullary disease represents lineage regression toward less-differentiated state with worse prognosis; t(11;14) MM has retained BCL2 dependency
